marks.gloss_en: דכתיב והיו לאותות ולמועדים ולימים ושנים -- the sun too is for seasons, days and years
the moon: because I said a proper thing before You, must I diminish myself?
והיינו דאמר ריש לקיש -- the New-Moon goat 'to the Lord' is the atonement for diminishing the moon
seeing she was not appeased, the Holy One said: bring atonement for Me, for I diminished the moon
אמר: היינו דרב אסי -- his garden sprouted only after he prayed and rain came
Rav Nachman bar Pappa had a garden; he sowed seeds and nothing sprouted; he prayed, rain came and it sprouted
it is written: 'and God made the two great lights' (Gen 1:16)
it is written 'and the earth brought forth grass' (Gen 1:12) -- on the third day
וכי משה רבינו קניגי היה או בליסטרי היה? -- Moses, no hunter or archer, could not have known such a creature
Rav Chanan bar Rava: 'ha-shesua' is a creature unto itself, which has two backs and two spines
תניא נמי הכי: עוים מתימן באו
the baraita: the Avvim came from Teiman
והעוים היושבים בחצרים -- a verse seemingly without consequence, which teaches how the Philistines' land became permitted to Israel
Resh Lakish: many verses seem fit to be burned like heretics' books, and they are the very body of Torah
כיוצא בדבר אתה אומר: כי חשבון עיר סיחן -- likewise, how Moab's land became permitted
והיינו דאמר רב פפא: עמון ומואב טיהרו בסיחון
'for Heshbon was the city of Sichon' (Num 21:26) -- what difference? since God told Israel 'do not besiege Moab' (Deut 2:9), He said: let Sichon take it from Moab, and Israel take it from Sichon
אמר חמשה וחשיב שיתא -- the verse says five lords and lists six
ארונקי שלהן חמשה -- their great ones were five (= p_arunkei_chamisha)
Rav Chisda to Rav Tachlifa bar Avina: write 'arunkei' in your aggada book and explain it
Rav Chisda to Rav Tachlifa bar Avina: go write 'hunter and archer' in your aggada book, and explain it

'and the Avvim that dwelt in villages as far as Gaza' (Deut 2:23) -- what difference to us? since Abimelech made Abraham swear (Gen 21:23), the Holy One said: let the Caphtorim take it from the Avvim, who are the Philistines, and let Israel take it from the Caphtorim
the tanna: Senir and Sirion are among the mountains of Eretz Yisrael
'and the people he removed to the cities' (Gen 47:21) -- what difference? that they not call his brothers exiles
ולא? והתניא: נשר... -- the baraita derives the signs from the nesher and the doves, so they were stated
the mishna: the signs of the [kosher] bird were not stated
